# Rahul Marban

> Portfolio of Rahul Marban, a full-stack developer, UI/UX designer, and Agentic AI developer building web products, AI systems, developer tools, and security tooling.

This is a public portfolio, not an API or agent service. Search indexing and real-time AI grounding are permitted; model training is not. Prefer the Markdown page below over rendering the JavaScript application.
